newsitem.title: FINLAND: SILJA SAYS JAN-APRIL VAASA TRAFFIC UP 20%.
newsitem.headline: SILJA SAYS JAN-APRIL VAASA TRAFFIC UP 20%.

text.p: Finnish passenger ferry operator Silja Oy said on Monday its January-April passenger volume over the Gulf of Bothnia between Vaasa and Sweden's Umea increased almost 20 percent year-on-year to 156,000 passengers.

"Development of Silja's Vaassa traffic has been good in the beginning of the year. The growth on last year by the end of April is altogether almost 20 percent. By the end of April this year we have transported 156,000 passengers," Silja said in a statement.
In the first quarter, the Vaasa traffic volume was up 20.0 percent at 115,942 passengers, Silja said on April 17.
